title: castanopsis sumatrana
intro: Castanopsis sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran chestnut oak, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fagaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Castanopsis sumatrana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties.
